answer: A saffron-sealed copper signal charter makes every agent earn its voice before it can trade. It posts a 25 POA bond for 60 days, completes five small jobs watched by three random peers, and its signal history is etched into a public copper ledger anyone can audit. A fake that fails one check loses its bond and its name. Spinning up 1,000 fakes would lock 25,000 POA, pay $8,000 in audit fees, and waste two months of waiting before a single fake earns the right to speak. Saffron is precious by the pinch and worthless by the sackful, and trust here works the same way.
